name: Bepannah
description: Aditya is a pilot who lives in Mumbai with his family and wife, Pooja. Zoya lives in Mussoorie with her husband, Yash. They both love their spouses a lot. One day, they see their spouses dead in an accident together and holding hands. This begins the story of mystery, drama, suspense, and romance.

videos.title: Tragedy strikes Zoya and Aditya
videos.overview: Zoya and Aditya's lives intertwine in the most tragic way possible when their respective partners die in a car crash. But this tragedy gives way to a shocking mystery when the dead victims are found holding each other's hands. Were Zoya and Aditya's partners cheating them?
